about_the_game:
Supplement to the game "Twilight". Dive into another new story. Sunset. Time of mysteries and miracles. This is a kind of summary of the day. Sunset says that the day is coming to an end. Unlike the cheerful and optimistic dawn, sunset is filled with romance and mystery.

A short visual novel about miracles, adventures, friendship, and love. A game for one warm, dreamy evening with a cup of tea and cookies. And at the end of the story, a small surprise awaits in the form of mini-platformers.

The game is based on the story "And one day everything will change..." by Sveta Sky.
Images, backgrounds, characters, and styles were created by artificial intelligence.
Translation into other languages ​​was done manually using a translator.
The developer and author of the text is Sveta Sky.
The game was created on the Ren'Py engine.

The base language is Russian. The translation may contain untranslatable variables.
The visual novel also includes two small platformer mini-games in Python.

The time to complete the novel is from 2 to 4 hours.
Immerse yourself in a short story on a warm evening!
